title: Dewback
caption: Dewback (V)
game_text: _If just drawn for a non-lightsaber weapon destiny, opponent loses 1 Force._ Deploys only to Tatooine. May add 1 ‘rider’ (passenger). Ability = ¼. During battle, may make a character here defense value -1.
lore: Protected by hard skin composed of tough armored scales. Frequently ridden by sandtroopers stationed in desert environments.
copyright: © LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1998 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Sheet group: Blockade (Dark Side). Non-unique (no dot). Banner CREATURE VEHICLE; stats POWER 2 / ARMOR 4 / LANDSPEED 2; deploy 2 / forfeit 4 (all as printed). No scomp ring, no column icons (only the VS15 set sphere). First sentence printed in italics (incl. its period). '¼' single fraction glyph, curly ‘rider’ quotes as printed. Printed text was 'Deploy only to a desert or Tatooine site. Ability = ¼. May add 1 ‘rider’ (passenger). When ‘ridden’ by a sandtrooper, may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.' Lore matches the wiki and the scan. Base SE-D-dewback.gif (350 px only); copyright SE-style 1998 legible; SE ring icon right of the lore box. Modern: Virtual Block 1 only (VB1-D-dewback-pre.gif, 350).
